description: qou-cds1 Step 27 (updated at 80 dps for canonical Borromean intra-ordering, qou-hu1f / qou-g5oz). The faithful object is `atom_braid_word_3A`, and the level-k binding operator Delta_bind = beta_atom - beta_free factors for the deuteron as P.(I-1).N (< 1e-75 across all 11 blocks of H_6 at 80 dps), making Delta_bind genuinely H_6-valued outside H_3 (x) H_3.
